01. The Challenge

How do you create a wedding invitation that feels like home when your home exists in two places?

Both Angela and Harold are originally from Colombia, but after many years in Australia, they now call it home. Angela lives in Sydney, Harold in Melbourne, while their families and traditions remain deeply connected to Colombia.

The challenge was to create a digital invitation that celebrated both parts of their journey, honoring where they came from while bringing loved ones together across countries, cultures and time zones.

Two Cultures, One Story
Honouring their Colombian roots while celebrating the life they've built in Australia.
Families Far Away
Bringing together loved ones from different countries and time zones.
A New Home
Australia became their home, a place they now call their own.
The beginning of our Forever ♥
02. The Concept

A journey, not just an invitation.

Rather than creating a traditional wedding website, we designed an experience that feels like a journey.

Every section was crafted to guide guests through Angela and Harold's story, from their Colombian roots to the life they've built in Australia, using elegant typography, cinematic imagery and subtle interactions.

Why watercolor?
To reflect their journey in a soft, artisanal and timeless way.
Why polaroids?
To capture real moments together, like keepsakes from their story.
Why serif typography?
To create an elegant and classic atmosphere that feels warm and personal.
Why travel elements?
Because their story is about crossing distances to build a life together.
Why warm colors?
To create connection and warm memories.
Why mobile-first?
To ensure a seamless experience across all devices for every guest.

08. What's Next

If I revisited this project

Ideas I'd love to explore if I continue this journey in the future.

Custom-built RSVP form
Create a fully custom RSVP experience without third-party forms for a more cohesive flow.
Guest photo upload gallery
Let guests upload their photos after the wedding to keep the memories all in one place.
Print-friendly view
Offer a clean, elegant print view for older relatives who prefer or appreciate printed info.
A documented mini design system
Organize components, tokens and patterns to make future iterations easier and faster.
